analysis_steps.goal: Build razor-thin and 3D LIME disk models with inflow

method.value: Velocity field with inward radial component chi*vK inside R_cav; LIME channel maps, sampled and deconvolved in CASA

evidence.quote: Both models treat the gas velocities within the cavity ($R<R_{\rm cav}$) as having an inward radial component that is some constant fraction $\chi$ of the local circular Keplerian velocity.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure wing rotation in HD 142527 CO channel maps

method.value: Intensity-weighted centroids of channel pairs blue/red-shifted by equal velocity; angle of connecting segment compared with constant-chi, variable-chi and warp models

evidence.quote: Pairs of these positions are constructed from channels blue- and red-shifted by the same velocity relative to the systemic channel.

findings_qualitative.value: Free-fall-like inflow at ~25-50 AU is consistent with data, but a warp reproduces the rotations equally well

evidence.quote: Nevertheless a warped disk at these radii can also reproduce the large, order-unity rotations seen in the CO and HCO$^+$ line wings.

claims.hypothesis: Fast radial inflow produces detectable twisted isophotes and wing rotation
claims.experiment: Razor-thin and LIME 3D models with chi variable
claims.result: Rotation angles predicted and measurable for realistic beams and S/N

evidence.quote: can detect inflow by virtue of its two key signatures: twisted isophotes at the systemic velocity, and rotated emission patterns in channel maps made in the line wings.

claims.experiment: Compare CO wing rotation with inflow and warp models
claims.result: Variable-chi inflow fits as well as a warp
claims.finding: Consistent with inflow but degenerate with a warp

evidence.quote: The variable $\chi$ model does as well as a warped disk model

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Warp, outflow, envelope infall, vertical structure and eccentricity considered as contaminants; eccentricity found not degenerate; warp is practically degenerate

evidence.quote: the warp-induced changes in the channel maps are practically identical to those induced by a radial inflow.
